title: 3732. Maximum Product of Three Elements After One Replacement

examples.explanation: Replacing 0 with -105 gives the array [-5, 7, -105], which has a product (-5) * 7 * (-105) = 3500000. The maximum product is 3500000.

Two ways to achieve the maximum product include: [-4, -2, -3] → replace -2 with 105 → product = (-4) * 105 * (-3) = 1200000. [-4, -1, -3] → replace -1 with 105 → product = (-4) * 105 * (-3) = 1200000. The maximum product is 1200000.
There is no way to replace an element with another integer and not have a 0 in the array. Hence, the product of all three elements will always be 0, and the maximum product is 0.
